name: wazuh
title: Wazuh
description: Pulls vulnerability findings from a Wazuh manager via its REST API. Provide WAZUH_URL (e.g. https://wazuh.example:55000), WAZUH_USERNAME, and WAZUH_PASSWORD as agent env vars. WAZUH_AGENT_IDS is a list of Wazuh agent IDs to query (e.g. 001, 002, 003 — use '000' for the manager itself). WAZUH_MIN_SEVERITY filters findings — valid values: Low | Medium | High | Critical.
